description: Connects a book review, published as a site.standard.document, to the book it reviews.

main.description: One per reviewed book. The record key is the book's BookHive ID (hiveId), so a reader's review of a book can be found with a single getRecord. A book BookHive doesn't hold is keyed by a stand-in instead, which is also its hiveId: isbn-… and the edition's ISBN-13, or resenha-… and the ink.resenha.reading's record key for a book with no ISBN. Records written before Resenha 1.6.10 may also be keyed popfeed-…, for a book the reader kept in Popfeed.

document.description: The site.standard.document that holds the review. Its content is the formatted review; its textContent is the same review as plain text.

book.description: The reader's record for the book: a buzz.bookhive.book or an ink.resenha.reading, whose review field holds the same review as plain text. A review published before Resenha 1.6.10 may still name a social.popfeed.feed.listItem, for a book the reader kept in Popfeed then. That record may since have been deleted, when the book moved to BookHive or a reading.

hiveId.description: The book's BookHive ID, or the stand-in the record is keyed by for a book BookHive doesn't hold. Also the record key.

spoiler.description: The reader marked the review as giving away parts of the book. The document carries the same mark as a "spoiler" self-label.

langs.description: The languages the review is written in, as the reader chose them. BCP-47 codes, as in a Bluesky post's langs.

bookRef.description: The book in every key anyone uses, so the review can be found for an edition no catalogue knows, by ISBN.

lineSpacing.description: The line spacing the writer chose, as a percentage of the font's own line height, as word processors count it. Known values: 100, 115, 150, 200. Absent for the usual spacing.

paragraphSpacing.description: The gap between paragraphs the writer chose, as a percentage of the text size. Known values: 40, 90, 150. Absent for the usual gap.

drawings.description: How Resenha drew the document's drawing blocks: the sheet behind each and its ruled lines, which the blocks themselves hold as ordinary fills and strokes. One entry per drawing with a background.

galleryImages.description: The layout the writer gave images inside the document's gallery blocks, which a gallery's images don't hold themselves. A single image block keeps its width and fullBleed in the block.

block.description: The drawing block's position in the document's content, counting from 0.

background.description: The sheet the drawing is on.

guideFills.description: The positions, from 0, of the block's fills that are the sheet rather than the writer's drawing.

guideStrokes.description: The positions, from 0, of the block's strokes that are ruled lines rather than the writer's drawing.

block.description: The gallery block's position in the document's content, counting from 0.

image.description: The image's position in the gallery, counting from 0.

width.description: The width the writer gave the image, in points, as a single image block's width.

fullBleed.description: The image runs to the page's edges, as a single image block's fullBleed.
